data.what: Base M1 damage per level (only Lv225 = 10 known)
data.test: On a fresh/alt character, unequip all gear/titles; hit a training dummy at several levels (e.g. 1, 50, 100, 150, 225) and note the damage number.

data.what: Additive vs multiplicative ADF
data.test: Lv225, no titles, Makomo/no-ADF clan if possible. (1) Insect Katana only -> damage D1. (2) + Flame Amigasa -> D2. (3) + Flame Haori Style 1 -> D3. Predictions: multiplicative D3 = 10 + 1.5*1.04*1.055*1.07 = 11.761; additive = 10 + 1.5*(1+0.04+0.055+0.07) = 11.748. Damage numbers are probably rounded to integers, so use large flat AD (e.g. a refined Nightfall weapon + Duelist gear) to amplify the difference.

data.what: Does ADF multiply base M1 or only Additional Damage?
data.test: Equip ONLY Flame Amigasa (ADF, no flat). If the damage stays 10, ADF only scales Additional Damage. If it becomes ~10.55 (maybe shown as 11), ADF multiplies the base too.
